libs.note: BH-6902. A QA run collects its findings first, then files ONE issue per screen or flow (gf_run). bin/postmerge-qa.sh calls it on a FAIL verdict. gf_run reads both knobs per board with lib_env_apply group-findings <board>, so a row lib.group-findings.<board>.<env lowercased> wins for that board.

knobs.note: 1: gf_run reads the open issues and PRs of the board's repo and files one issue per screen or flow, or comments on the open one. 0 (the default): no GitHub call, every ledger row is `off`. Turn it on per board with the row lib.group-findings.<board>.group_findings. Read as ${GROUP_FINDINGS:-0}.

The lowest severity (1 low, 2 medium, 3 high, 4 critical) at which a finding with class data-leak or launch-blocker is filed at once as its own issue. It also stays in its group's checklist. Read as ${GROUP_FINDINGS_URGENT_RANK:-3}.
